#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Value-free receipt data for the 2026-09-28 restore of this host's Claude skill listing.

Usage:
  python3 listing_receipt.py data --checkout <checkout> --captures <coordinator capture directory>
      --backups <settings backup directory>
  python3 listing_receipt.py receipt --checkout <checkout> --captures <dir> --skeleton <skeleton.json>
      --backups <settings backup directory>

Reads, and never writes:
  * the coordinator's captures: pre-/post-status.json (scripts/skills_status.py --json),
    pre-/post-usage.json (tools/skill-usage/skill_usage.py --run-skill-doctor --json), their
    exit-code, time and apply files, and restore_listing.py (the edit script);
  * the settings backups named below, through scripts/skills_status.py's own
    load_skill_overrides (only the skillOverrides object leaves it), keeping only the fixed
    state strings or "absent" per manifest skill;
  * the Codex backup labels, for existence only (their content is not opened).
Output holds labels, UTC stamps, state strings, counts, digests and the manifest's public skill
names: no settings value other than the four state strings, no path, no session identifier.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import re
import subprocess
import sys
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from pathlib import Path

TARGETS_14 = ["agentic-actions-auditor", "codeql", "diagnosing-bugs", "frontend-design", "gh-address-comments",
              "gh-fix-ci", "modern-python", "resolving-merge-conflicts", "sarif-parsing", "security-best-practices",
              "security-threat-model", "semgrep", "tdd", "variant-analysis"]
TARGETS_15 = TARGETS_14 + ["writing-for-agents"]
SETTINGS_LABELS = ["settings.json.20260926T200020Z.pre-skills-off",
                   "settings.json.20260926T201239Z.pre-skills-nameonly",
                   "settings.json.bak.20260927T053110Z.agent-teams",
                   "settings.json.20260928T150902Z.pre-listing-restore"]
CODEX_LABELS = ["codex-config.toml.20260926T200118Z.pre-skills-off",
                "codex-config.toml.20260926T201239Z.pre-skills-reenable"]
CAPTURES = ["pre-status.json", "pre-usage.json", "pre-usage.err", "pre-time.txt", "pre-exit.txt", "apply.txt",
            "post-status.json", "post-usage.json", "post-usage.err", "post-time.txt", "post-exit.txt",
            "restore_listing.py"]
STATES = ["on", "name-only", "user-invocable-only", "off"]


def stamp_of(label: str) -> str:
    token = next(part for part in label.split(".") if len(part) == 16 and part[8] == "T" and part.endswith("Z"))
    return datetime.strptime(token, "%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ").strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")


def parse_utc(text: str) -> datetime:
    return datetime.fromisoformat(text.replace("Z", "+00:00"))


def hours(start: str, end: str) -> float:
    return round((parse_utc(end) - parse_utc(start)).total_seconds() / 3600, 2)


def status_summary(report: dict, exit_code: int) -> dict:
    skills = {skill["name"]: skill for skill in report["skills"]}
    checks = ("canonical", "claude_link", "lock", "codex_disable")
    return {
        "command": "python3 scripts/skills_status.py --json",
        "exit": exit_code,
        "result": report["result"],
        "skills_checked": len(skills),
        "failing_skills": sum(not skill["pass"] for skill in skills.values()),
        "claude_listing_mismatches": sum(skill["claude_listing"]["state"] != "ok" for skill in skills.values()),
        "other_required_checks_not_ok": {name: sum(skill[name]["state"] != "ok" for skill in skills.values())
                                         for name in checks},
        "targets": {name: {"actual": skills[name]["claude_listing"]["actual"],
                           "state": skills[name]["claude_listing"]["state"]} for name in TARGETS_15},
        "folder_trees": report["folder_trees"],
        "claude_settings_state": report["claude_settings"]["state"],
        "codex_config_state": report["codex_config"]["state"],
        "lock": report["lock"],
        "budget": {"claude_on_description_chars": report["budget"]["claude_on_description_chars"]["computed"],
                   "matches_manifest": report["budget"]["claude_on_description_chars"]["matches_manifest"],
                   "claude_on_cap": report["budget"]["claude_on_cap"],
                   "claude_within_cap": report["budget"]["claude_within_cap"]},
    }


def usage_summary(report: dict, exit_code: int, stderr_bytes: int) -> dict:
    skills = {skill["name"]: skill for skill in report["skills"]}
    targets = {name: {key: skills[name]["claude"][key] for key in ("context_tokens", "uses", "last_used")}
               for name in TARGETS_15}
    return {
        "command": "python3 tools/skill-usage/skill_usage.py --run-skill-doctor --json",
        "exit": exit_code,
        "stderr_bytes": stderr_bytes,
        "generated_at": report["generated_at"],
        "claude": {key: report["claude"][key] for key in ("measured", "origin", "num_turns", "total_cost_usd")},
        "codex_measured": report["codex"]["measured"],
        "targets": targets,
        "context_tokens_the_14": sum(targets[name]["context_tokens"] for name in TARGETS_14),
        "context_tokens_all_15": sum(targets[name]["context_tokens"] for name in TARGETS_15),
        "uses_the_14": sum(targets[name]["uses"] for name in TARGETS_14),
        "prune_candidates": len(report["prune_candidates"]),
        "verdict_recheck": len(report["verdict_recheck"]),
    }


def exits(text: str) -> dict:
    return {line.split(" exit=")[0].strip(): int(line.split(" exit=")[1]) for line in text.splitlines() if " exit=" in line}


def build(checkout: Path, captures: Path, backups_dir: Path) -> dict:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(checkout / "scripts"))
    import skills_status

    manifest = skills_status.load_manifest(checkout / "adoption/skills/manifest.json")
    expected = {skill["name"]: skill["claude_listing"] for skill in manifest["skills"]}
    read = {name: (captures / name).read_bytes() for name in CAPTURES}
    pre_exit, post_exit = exits(read["pre-exit.txt"].decode()), exits(read["post-exit.txt"].decode())
    pre_status, post_status = json.loads(read["pre-status.json"]), json.loads(read["post-status.json"])
    pre_usage, post_usage = json.loads(read["pre-usage.json"]), json.loads(read["post-usage.json"])
    apply_fields = read["apply.txt"].decode().split()
    apply = dict(zip(apply_fields[0::2], apply_fields[1::2]))
    applied_utc = datetime.strptime(apply["applied_utc"], "%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ").strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")

    backups = []
    for label in SETTINGS_LABELS:
        overrides, state = skills_status.load_skill_overrides(backups_dir / label)
        groups: dict[str, list[str]] = {key: [] for key in STATES + ["absent", "invalid_value"]}
        for name in expected:
            value = overrides.get(name, "absent")
            groups[value if value in STATES or value == "absent" else "invalid_value"].append(name)
        effective = {name: (overrides.get(name, "on") if overrides.get(name, "on") in STATES else "invalid_value")
                     for name in expected}
        backups.append({
            "label": label, "utc": stamp_of(label), "read_state": state,
            "skillOverrides_keys": len(overrides),
            "manifest_skills_by_state": {key: value for key, value in groups.items() if value},
            "the_14_effective": {key: sum(effective[name] == key for name in TARGETS_14) for key in STATES},
            "the_14_absent": [name for name in TARGETS_14 if name not in overrides],
            "writing_for_agents": overrides.get("writing-for-agents", "absent"),
            "effective_mismatches_with_manifest": sorted(name for name in expected if effective[name] != expected[name]),
        })
    codex = [{"label": label, "utc": stamp_of(label), "present": (backups_dir / label).is_file()}
             for label in CODEX_LABELS]

    installed = {skill["name"]: skill["installed_at"] for skill in post_usage["skills"]}
    trial_11 = [name for name in TARGETS_14 if name not in ("gh-fix-ci", "security-best-practices", "variant-analysis")]
    plus30 = lambda text: (parse_utc(text) + timedelta(days=30)).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")
    uses = {skill["name"]: (skill["claude"]["listing"], skill["claude"]["uses"]) for skill in post_usage["skills"]}
    version = subprocess.run(["claude", "--version"], capture_output=True, text=True, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                             timeout=60, check=False).stdout.strip()
    return {
        "client_version_at_recording": version,
        "pre_edit": {"capture_utc": read["pre-time.txt"].decode().strip(),
                     "skills_status": status_summary(pre_status, pre_exit["pre-status"]),
                     "skill_usage": usage_summary(pre_usage, pre_exit["pre-usage"], len(read["pre-usage.err"]))},
        "apply": {"applied_utc": applied_utc, "backup_label": apply["backup_label"],
                  "skillOverrides_keys_after": int(apply["skillOverrides_keys"]),
                  "edit_script_sha256": hashlib.sha256(read["restore_listing.py"]).hexdigest()},
        "post_edit": {"capture_utc": read["post-time.txt"].decode().strip(),
                      "skills_status": status_summary(post_status, post_exit["post-status"]),
                      "skill_usage": usage_summary(post_usage, post_exit["post-usage"], len(read["post-usage.err"]))},
        "host_backups": {"settings": backups, "codex_labels": codex},
        "segments": {
            "all_14_effectively_on_at": stamp_of(SETTINGS_LABELS[0]),
            "the_14_off_at": stamp_of(SETTINGS_LABELS[1]),
            "off_bounded_minutes": round((parse_utc(stamp_of(SETTINGS_LABELS[1]))
                                          - parse_utc(stamp_of(SETTINGS_LABELS[0]))).total_seconds() / 60, 1),
            "the_14_name_only_at": [stamp_of(SETTINGS_LABELS[2]), stamp_of(SETTINGS_LABELS[3])],
            "restored_utc": applied_utc,
            "variant_analysis_installed_at": installed["variant-analysis"],
            "variant_analysis_hours_on_before_backup": hours(installed["variant-analysis"], stamp_of(SETTINGS_LABELS[0])),
            "name_only_hours_at_most": hours(stamp_of(SETTINGS_LABELS[1]), applied_utc),
            "restored_window_ends": plus30(applied_utc),
        },
        "skill_usage_30_day_age_reached": {
            "trial_11_installed_2026_09_25": [min(plus30(installed[name]) for name in trial_11),
                                              max(plus30(installed[name]) for name in trial_11)],
            "variant_analysis": plus30(installed["variant-analysis"]),
            "kept_pair": sorted({plus30(installed[name]) for name in ("gh-fix-ci", "security-best-practices")}),
        },
        "observational_lifetime_uses_post_edit": {
            "listed_on_with_uses": {name: count for name, (listing, count) in uses.items() if listing == "on" and count},
            "name_only_with_uses": {name: count for name, (listing, count) in uses.items() if listing == "name-only" and count},
            "the_14": {name: uses[name][1] for name in TARGETS_14},
        },
        "capture_files": [{"name": name, "bytes": len(read[name]), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(read[name]).hexdigest()}
                          for name in CAPTURES],
    }


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("mode", choices=["data", "receipt"])
    parser.add_argument("--checkout", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--captures", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--skeleton")
    parser.add_argument("--backups", required=True, help="the host's settings backup directory (never recorded)")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    checkout, captures = Path(args.checkout).resolve(), Path(args.captures).resolve()
    data = build(checkout, captures, Path(args.backups).expanduser().resolve())
    if args.mode == "data":
        print(json.dumps(data, indent=1))
        return 0
    receipt = json.loads(Path(args.skeleton).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    receipt["recorded_at_utc"] = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")
    receipt["data"] = data
    own = Path(__file__).read_bytes()
    edit = (captures / "restore_listing.py").read_bytes()
    # The edit script names the host's backup directory on one line; the receipt embeds it with that line's
    # right-hand side replaced, and records the original file's digest beside the embedded text's digest.
    redacted, count = re.subn(r"(?m)^backups = Path\.home\(\).*$",
                              'backups = Path("<settings backup directory>")  # redacted in this receipt',
                              edit.decode("utf-8"))
    if count != 1:
        raise SystemExit(f"expected one backup-directory line in the edit script, found {count}")
    receipt["provenance"]["command"] = ("TMPDIR=/var/tmp python3 listing_receipt.py receipt --checkout <checkout> "
                                        "--captures <coordinator capture directory> --skeleton <skeleton> "
                                        "--backups <settings backup directory>")
    receipt["provenance"]["script_sha256"] = hashlib.sha256(own).hexdigest()
    receipt["provenance"]["script"] = own.decode("utf-8")
    receipt["provenance"]["edit_script_sha256"] = hashlib.sha256(edit).hexdigest()
    receipt["provenance"]["edit_script_redacted_sha256"] = hashlib.sha256(redacted.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
    receipt["provenance"]["edit_script_redacted"] = redacted
    ordered = {key: value for key, value in receipt.items() if key not in ("data", "provenance")}
    ordered["data"], ordered["provenance"] = receipt["data"], receipt["provenance"]
    print(json.dumps(ordered, indent=1))
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
provenance.edit_script_redacted:
"""Restore the Claude listing of the 14 drifted skills to the manifest's "on", and add an explicit
writing-for-agents "on". Touches only the skillOverrides key of ~/.claude/settings.json; prints
listing states and counts, never any other key. Usage: restore_listing.py check|apply"""
import json
import os
import shutil
import sys
import tempfile
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

TARGETS = ["agentic-actions-auditor", "codeql", "diagnosing-bugs", "frontend-design",
           "gh-address-comments", "gh-fix-ci", "modern-python", "resolving-merge-conflicts",
           "sarif-parsing", "security-best-practices", "security-threat-model", "semgrep", "tdd",
           "variant-analysis", "writing-for-agents"]
assert len(TARGETS) == 15 and len(set(TARGETS)) == 15

path = Path.home() / ".claude" / "settings.json"
backups = Path("<settings backup directory>")  # redacted in this receipt
text = path.read_text()
data = json.loads(text)
overrides = data["skillOverrides"]
print({name: overrides.get(name, "<absent>") for name in TARGETS})
print("roundtrip_exact", json.dumps(data, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n" == text)

if sys.argv[1] == "apply":
    others_before = {k: v for k, v in overrides.items() if k not in TARGETS}
    keys_before = list(data)
    stamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")
    backup = backups / f"settings.json.{stamp}.pre-listing-restore"
    shutil.copy2(path, backup)
    os.chmod(backup, 0o600)
    for name in TARGETS:
        overrides[name] = "on"
    out = json.dumps(data, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n"
    fd, tmp = tempfile.mkstemp(dir=path.parent, prefix=".settings.", suffix=".tmp")
    with os.fdopen(fd, "w") as handle:
        handle.write(out)
    os.chmod(tmp, os.stat(path).st_mode & 0o777)
    os.replace(tmp, path)
    after = json.loads(path.read_text())
    assert list(after) == keys_before
    assert {k: v for k, v in after["skillOverrides"].items() if k not in TARGETS} == others_before
    assert all(after["skillOverrides"][n] == "on" for n in TARGETS)
    print("backup_label", backup.name, "applied_utc", stamp,
          "skillOverrides_keys", len(after["skillOverrides"]))
